evidence.quote: The agent sometimes generates semantically incorrect code, leading to an edit-Python loop. As context length grows, its reasoning weakens, trapping it in an unproductive cycle without a clear exit (see 15)
We currently allocate compute using a static method with fixed depth and no early stopping, which limits our efficiency.

However, due to inherent limitations of editing abilities of the agent, the agent sometimes outputs syntactically incorrect code which degrades its reasoning (Kuratov et al., 2024) capa- bilities and takes up its computational budget.
We propose to implement absolute path scoring to guide exploration depth and stopping decisions, while maintaining an upper depth limit.
